integrity.verification_method: Independent finite-state enumeration and exact-integer convolution with asymptotic numerical agreement. Infinite limits are established by analytic proof, not finite computations.

scientific_limitations: Applies to canonical product weights with a fixed finite positive-weight bulk range and a constant occupied-cluster weight.
Requires supercritical particle density and a strictly finite, positive quadratic fast-rate scaling limit.
No rates of convergence, dynamical mixing, or critical-density and alternate-tail results are claimed.
Unindexed equivalent stationary condensate laws remain a possible originality risk.
title: Bessel-distributed condensate counts and Dirichlet clusters at the fast-rate zero-range transition
